This policy applies to any information collected through our systems and/or when you use our services. This policy does not apply to, nor does Jetking take any responsibility for, any information collected by a third party.
Introduction

Your privacy is valuable to us. We do not sell or forward or rent your personal information that you share with Jetking Infotrain Limited, to any third party for any purposes like marketing, etc. without your explicit consent. This statement of privacy is applicable to our services available under the domain name www.jetking.com and any other connected sub-domain names and applies generally to subsidiaries of Jetking Infotrain Limited. Your use of the Jetking Infotrain Limited website signifies your acceptance of the Jetking Privacy Statement.

Jetking strives to comply with applicable laws that are designed to protect your privacy.Any presentation of the terms of this Privacy Policy shall be in accordance with the “terms of use” on the website.
Log Files

The Jetking website uses log files to keep track of visitors’ activities when they visit the site. If you use a web-hosting service, this is a part of their analytics.These log files collect information such as IP addresses, browser types, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamps, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These data are not associated with any personal information in any way.This information is used for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movements on the site, and gathering demographic data.
Jetking’s Principles to Protect Privacy
In order to protect your privacy, Jetking has adopted the following principles:
(a) Security

Wherever your Personal Information or Credentials may be held within Jetking Infotrain Ltd., the company intends to take necessary steps to protect it from unauthorized access or declaration. Jetking is committed to protecting the security of your personal information. We use a variety of security technologies and procedures to help protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. For example, we store the personal information you provide on computer systems with limited access, which are located in controlled facilities.
(b) Choice

You may choose whether or not to provide Personal Information to Jetking. The notice Jetking intends to provide at the point where it collects Personal Information on the Site or its official blog, should help you to make this choice. If you choose not to share your Personal Data that we request, you can still visit most of Jetking’s Web sites, but you may be unable to access certain options, offers, and services that involve our contact with you. If you chose to have a relationship with Jetking, such as a contractual or other business relationship, Jetking will naturally continue to contact you in connection with that business relationship.
(c) Notice

Where Jetking collects Personal Information on the Site or Blog, Jetking intends to post a purpose statement that explains why Personal Information will be collected and whether Jetking plans to share such Personal Information outside of Jetking or with those working on Jetking’s behalf. Unless the transfer of Personal Information is legally required, Jetking does not intend to transfer Personal Information without your permission to third parties who are not bound to act on Jetking’s behalf.
(d) Access/Accuracy

To the extent that you do provide Jetking with Personal Information, Jetking wishes to maintain accurate Personal Information. Where Jetking collects Personal Information from you on the Site, its aim is to provide a means of contacting Jetking should you need to update or correct that Information. If for any reason those means are unavailable or inaccessible, you may send updates and corrections about your Personal Information to info@jetking.com and Jetking will make reasonable efforts to incorporate the changes.
Your Consent

By using this Web site, you consent to the terms of Jetking’s Privacy Policy and to Jetking’s processing of Personal Information for the purposes given above. There are times, however, when Jetking may need information from you, such as your name and address. When information is needed, Jetking will try (but is not obligated) to let you know at the time of collection, how it will use the personal information. Usually, the personal information Jetking collects is used only by it to respond to your inquiry, process an order, or allow you to access specific account information. Occasionally, Jetking may make the e-mail addresses, of those who provide information, available to other reputable organizations whose products or services it thinks you may find interesting. In these cases, you will be offered an opportunity to limit access to your information. In case Jetking does not receive any response from you to limit the access of your information, it shall be deemed that you consent to such distribution of your Personal Information as mentioned above.
Jetking’s disclosure of your information

items.text: For the purpose of alumni interaction or academic interaction amongst the enrolled students
For the purpose of intra-business interaction among various subsidiaries of Jetking.

blocks.text: Affiliated/Connected sites

We offer some of our valuable services in connection with other websites. Personal information that you provide to those sites may be sent to Jetking in order to deliver the service. We process such information in accordance with this Policy. If the affiliated websites have different privacy policy practices then the user is required to read their privacy policies before using them.
Information We Collect

We will only collect information that you voluntarily share with us. You are in control of what information or data you share with us. Your information will only be collected if you choose to share it through Jetking’s Systems. The following information will be collected about you or relating to your use of the Jetking’s systems:

items.text: Any personal or PII that you may submit or may be required to submit for registration and continued use of the Jetking’s Systems or receive the services by Jetking.

Your name, title, gender, date of birth, email ID, Contact number, State/Country/Pin code, postal address, and details of respective social handles, such as Linkedin, Twitter, Facebook., Instagram, Snapchat, etc., along with IP addresses and other information collected.
Any other information you wish to share with us without limitation, including any information that will allow us to make your account or profile more current.

blocks.text: If required, you can complete all forms, provide comments to surveys, or create any content on our servers.
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

We follow GDPR guidelines. General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is designed to give EU citizens greater security over personal information. It’s a plan to establish a comprehensive privacy and security law that will safeguard Personal Data. Irrespective of the location they are located in, the GDPR applies to all relevant processors or controllers who handle personal information which is owned by EU citizens. For more details, please refer to GDPR: (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation)
Cookies

The cookies installed by the Jetking shall be exclusively for the purpose of retrieving information from you which pertains to be useful for the purpose of running the Course of Jetking institution or Hardware & Networking Institutes of Jetking. Cookies shall, have limited scope, either for the purpose of students’ enrollment for imparting computer hardware & networking education or for the prospective business parties who will be availing the services of various Jetking Learning Centres.
Children’s Information

Another area of our concern is to ensure that children are protected when they use the internet. We urge parents and guardians or participate in or monitor and direct their children’s online activities.

Jetking does not intend to collect any Personally Identifiable Information from children who are under 13 years of age. If you believe that your child/children may have provided the kind of information we collect on our website, We strongly urge you to notify the same to us immediately and we will make the best we can to erase the information or data from our databases.
Changes in privacy policy

Please note that this Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy”) may change from time to time without notice. We will not reduce or limit your rights under this Policy without your explicit consent, and we expect most such changes will be a little. Nonetheless, we will post any Privacy Policy changes on this page and, if the changes are significant, we will provide a more important notice. Each and every version of this Privacy Policy will be recognized at the top of the page by its effective date.
If you have any questions, or queries about this Policy, please feel free to contact us any time through this website.
How do we track?

Google Analytics – The third-party solutions described in this section allow Jetking to track and analyze the traffic on both services and websites. Google Analytics (Google Inc.) is an online analysis service that utilizes the data collected to monitor, study, and optimize the use by users of Websites and Services to prepare reports. Data collected includes cookies and usage information.
How do we use your information?

Jetking will process the information you provide as Personal Data only in accordance with the terms of this policy. If you do not want Jetking to keep using Your Personal Data in this manner you may request deletion of your account through your account settings. We will only collect the information you provide us with Personal Data if we have an appropriate legal basis to do it, and this includes but isn’t limited to the following:

items.text: Assess the technical aspects of service and website issues.
Announcements, newsletters and other educational materials, and other information on events.
Send you administrative messages like notices relating to the Services or changes to the policy.
Know, how websites and Services are used to improve and enhance their performance.
Reduce, prevent, detect and examine suspicious or illegal activities.
Respecting all legal obligations and resolving conflicts between customers, and enforcing our agreements.
Inquiring, defending, and preventing dangerous, fraudulent, illegal, or unauthorized activity.

blocks.text: Questions or suggestions

If you have any questions about Jetking’s Privacy Policy, collection, use, or disclosure of your personal information, please e-mail us at info@jetking.com. Jetking reserves its right to change, modify or update this privacy statement at any time without notice.
